The '''Danoor Resistance''' was an underground insurgency created to counter the [[Minister]] [[Waric Nane]]'s plans to convert [[Danoor]]'s government into a totalitarian regime. [[Minister]] [[Mooren]] was a member of the Resistance, and they had access to at least six [[Variant Z-95 Headhunter|modified Headhunters]]. Members of the Resistance fought alongside the ''[[FarStar]]'' during the [[Battle of Danoor]].
